title: Solar System Probes for Scalar Field Dark Matter
summary: Scalar field dark matter provides us with a well motivated alternative to conventional particle dark matter, especially when ultralight fields form coherent oscillations or compact self gravitating clumps. Here we develop three complementary Solar System and local Galactic level probes of such models. These probes pertain to ADAF-like flares from scalar clump encounters with Kuiper Belt Objects, atomic clock searches for oscillatory variations of fundamental constants and astrometric microlensing by compact scalar clumps.
